rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for deliberately causing a person or animal to die.

example.english: They decided to kill that person.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 jiu3 saat3 go2 go3 jan4

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when someone is wasting or passing time.

example.traditional: 我哋唔好喺度揼時間啦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 dam2 si4 gaan3 laa1

rows.note: Use this for cancelling or stopping a plan, event, decision, or piece of work rather than physically killing something.

example.english: The team had to kill the project because it ran out of money.
example.traditional: 因為冇錢，個團隊取消咗個計劃。
example.jyutping: jan1 wai6 mou5 cin2 go3 tyun4 deoi6 ceoi2 siu1 zo2 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this when something is unbearably painful or distressing, as in tight shoes that are killing your feet.

example.english: These shoes are so tight they could kill my feet.
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi3 haai4 gam3 zaak3 zan1 hai6 lo2 meng6
